mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_check_item (run_id, item_key, status, note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{runId} AS uuid), #{itemKey}, #{status}, #{note}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (run_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, note = EXCLUDED.note, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, item_key, status, note, created_at, updated_at FROM evaluation_check_item WHERE run_id = CAST(#{runId} AS uuid) ORDER BY item_key ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM evaluation_check_item WHERE run_id = CAST(#{runId} AS uuid)
